planets.name: K2-316 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-316 with a 1.13-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: K2-316 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-316. Its orbit and size follow Castro González et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
